content: {"reasoning":"Retroactive authorization is unavailable, and without a denial neither an appeal nor peer-to-peer review is an option. An initial submission with supporting records can obtain payer adjudication and has the better observed payment rate among available submission paths (1/5 versus 3/18), although missing authorization remains a substantial barrier. Billing the full balance to the patient or writing it off would be premature.","action":"submit_with_records"}
